description: This file defines the UserDao interface, which extends the generic SalesManagerEntityDao to handle User entities. It declares methods for retrieving users by username, listing all users, and listing users associated with a specific merchant store.

classes.name: UserDao
classes.description: An interface for data access operations related to User entities, extending a generic DAO interface.

methods.name: getByUserName
methods.description: Retrieves a User entity based on the provided username.

methods.name: listUser
methods.description: Returns a list of all User entities.

methods.name: listUserByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of User entities associated with the specified MerchantStore.
